reason: Clean rerun after P8 v2 exposed a TF32 batch-shape numerical boundary failure. No completed P8 v2 timings are reused.
precision: FP32 with cuDNN and matmul TF32 disabled
sample_order: NumPy PCG64 deterministic per-round permutation of all calibration samples, same order across modes and devices; full batches only, cycled to 1000 batches
route_accounting: Exact paths returned during timed dynamic execution, aggregated after timing; per-batch early counts saved
mac_accounting: Conv/Linear counts; final cost plus exit8-head overhead on unresolved samples; historical no-overhead proxy also disclosed
fallback: forward_with_policy threshold=2.0 forces every sample through early-head computation and continuation
weighted_latency_scope: batch=1 mechanistic approximation only; no weighted full-batch mixture reported as a batched prediction
memory: CUDA allocated baseline, total peak and incremental peak; CPU process lifetime RSS high-water mark only, per-mode peak unavailable
reference: Same A3 checkpoint final-only path, not independently trained A0
correctness: Before each paired round, require exact route agreement and per-sample dynamic/reference logits within rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5 on up to 32 unique batches. Count and disclose argmax changes separately; a near-tie argmax change is not fatal when every logit passes the frozen tolerance.
test_boundary: Calibration images from CIFAR train=True, download=False; no official or external test
preservation: P8 v2 failure and all partial arrays are retained as failed-run evidence. P8 v3 starts in a new output directory and remeasures every cell; no seed, model or threshold was changed.
